topic.source_contract: English marine-plan policy assessment, marine licensing, environmental information, wildlife permissions and delivery evidence

facts.status: statutory marine plans guide decisions in English marine areas
facts.guard: policy alignment is not a marine licence
application guidance is not a decision

facts.permissions: licence, exemption and other-authority permissions must be checked
facts.guard: one permission does not replace others

facts.application: standard licence application and post-decision route

facts.assessment: marine-plan policy assessment and possible EIA information

scope_guards: Marine-plan policy alignment is not treated as a marine licence.
An application is not treated as a granted or effective licence.
A marine licence is not treated as planning permission, land rights or harbour authority consent.
An exemption is not assumed without exact activity and conditions.
Marine mapping is not treated as an exact current constraint decision.
EIA screening or scoping is not treated as project approval.
Wildlife-licence and Habitats Regulations duties are not conflated with the marine licence.
No score or promotion is written without exact location, activity, plan assessment, licences, rights, conditions and delivery evidence.
